text:
incident-bot: Paging @tj (oncall) — Canary for model:v2b showing elevated errors and tokenization failures on /v1/generate. Canary error rate increased from ~0.6% to 18%. Affected region: us-west-2. Timestamp: 2026-03-17T14:03:00Z

tj: on it, joining VC. Can you paste a quick sample log line?

elaine: logs show tokenizer errors like `UnknownTokenSequence` + vocab mismatch. Weight checksums look normal. From `deploy-manifest`: tokenizerRef: token-v3b (expected token-v3a). Suspect artifact promotion/tagging bug.

sasha: that sounds like a tag flip during promote step. cc @mike — did the tagging job run for this artifact?

mike: tagging job completed but saw intermittent 409 on the registry push ~14:01 UTC; retry logic might've promoted wrong tag. Investigating registry logs now.

deploy-bot: Canary traffic for model:v2b is currently 12% of total traffic to /v1/generate endpoints. Canary hosts: canary-14, canary-15, canary-16.

tj: prioritize mitigation — emergency feature-flag flip to stop canary. Elaine, can you confirm rollback plan?

elaine: propose two-step: 1) flip canary flag (stop routing to v2b) 2) repromote correct tokenizer artifact and run canary again behind staging tests. If quick rollback needed, we can pin canary to token-v3a.

sasha: +1. We should avoid full traffic rollback until we confirm weights are fine (they appear ok). Tokenizer drift only.

tj: flipping emergency flag now — `feature-flags set --name model_v2b_canary --value false`

deploy-bot: feature-flag `model_v2b_canary` set to `false` by tj at 14:06:18 UTC. Routing update queued.

incident-bot: Canary traffic reduced to 0% within 35s; requests are now routed to last-stable (model:v2a). Error rate for /v1/generate back to baseline ~0.7%.

mike: registry logs: push for tokenizer token-v3b had a race that resulted in token-v3b pointing to an older build (sha mismatch). We'll roll the correct token-v3a into canary tag.

elaine: executing quick pin:
```
router update --model v2b --tokenizer token-v3a --env canary
service deploy --model v2b --tokenizer token-v3a --wait 60s
```

jordan: ops/customer-facing note: no SLO breaches yet but some high-volume customers saw increased retry rates; CS notified and monitoring onboarded.

product-ops: preparing a short status post for impacted customers — will send draft in 20m.

sasha: after pinning, run end-to-end smoke: generator sanity, embedding consistency, and 50 request sample. I'll run the smoke harness.

elaine: smoke passed on canary pinned to token-v3a. No tokenization errors in sample. Rolling canary back to active gradually only after internal signoff.

tj: handing off to infra oncall for post-rollback verification and postmortem. I'll stay as incident lead until the ticket is created.

mike: root cause: registry tagging race on promotion job. Action items: add a stronger push-and-verify step in promote job, make registry push idempotent, and add artifact checksum gating on router.

incident-bot: Created incident ticket INC-2026-1123 (category: release/deploy). Pager escalations silenced.

product-ops: posting update to customers at 14:40 UTC: short summary + impact (limited retries, no data loss).

tj: thanks team. We'll follow up with a short postmortem and a list of action owners. Remaining oncall: elaine (infra), mike (registry), sasha (deploy).

elaine: logging evidence and attaching logs to INC-2026-1123. Closing live mitigation channel — reopening if we see regression. :white_check_mark: 

jordan: noted, will monitor customer signals for 2 hours and report back. :eyes:
